headline: Youth-facing AI literacy resources and instructor packs
digest: Digital Moment and the Canadian Commission for UNESCO launched 'AI in Your Everyday Life', a bilingual hub for youth aged 13 to 18 with games, a glossary and educator and family guides. Amii expanded its AI Workforce Readiness program with discipline-specific curriculum packages for post-secondary instructors and a three-hour 'Module 0' AI literacy unit used across a 57-institution consortium.
